run_normal_map_inference: run the demo to infer surface normal maps from images using a config and checkpoint file
run_normal_vis_with_directory: run the demo on a directory of images and save normal map visualizations to an output folder
run_normal_vis_with_txt: run the demo using a text file listing image paths and save normalized normal maps as numpy files
run_normal_vis_with_mask: run the demo with a segmentation directory to mask out regions when visualizing normal maps
run_normal_vis_on_cpu: run the demo on CPU by setting device to cpu and reverting sync batch normalization
